title: Pin and document the PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE refusal of continuable subagents

source.anchor: Resolve the persistence service continuable children require, or fail loud.

task:
Problem: continuable children require a session-persistence backend. `requirePersistence()` at packages/subagent/subagent/src/continuation.ts:1470-1478 throws `SubagentError` with code `PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE` and is reached from `startContinuable` (continuation.ts:403-407) and from cold continuation (`coldResume`, continuation.ts:883-889). No test in the repository asserts that code: every continuation spec composes `dsh-session-persistence` (for example packages/subagent/subagent/tests/continuation.spec.ts:189), and the README's `startContinuable` row (packages/subagent/subagent/README.md:19) and continuable-Activation section (README.md:103) never name the failure. A deployment that mounts a continuable delegation tool without a backend therefore has no documented, pinned refusal.

Required: add packages/subagent/subagent/tests/persistence-unavailable.spec.ts that composes the service with a scripted provider but without `dsh-session-persistence` (reuse the fixtures of tests/service.spec.ts or tests/continuation.spec.ts), calls `startContinuable(...)`, and asserts rejection with a `SubagentError` whose `code` is `PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE` and whose message names the backend to load, and that no child session was created and no `subagent/start` event was emitted; cover the cold-continuation entry the same way if the fixture can reach it. Document the code in the README next to `startContinuable`, English and Chinese together, then re-record with `pnpm run verify-translation-pairing --write packages/subagent/subagent/README.md`.

Constraints: no source change beyond documentation; do not weaken the refusal into a warning. The coverage check runs the subagent packages whose tests own this package's src; until T-0020 merges, packages/subagent/subagent/tests/out-of-process.spec.ts:77 fails under uid 0 for a reason unrelated to this ticket, so run acceptance as a non-root user or after T-0020.
